limitations: Fetch accepts an Otter meeting ID extracted from a canonical https://otter.ai/u/MEETING_ID recording URI; it does not search the user's account or infer a meeting from a title.
Transcript response normalization remains fail-closed for unobserved response shapes until an authorized meeting response supplies private conformance evidence.
The identity-only probe can establish authentication and reachability but leaves meeting.transcript.read compatibility unknown.
